title: Bonds exempt from taxation.
bodyText: Bonds and the income therefrom issued pursuant to this chapter shall be exempt from all state and county taxation except estate and transfer taxes.
bodyHtml: §206J-14  Bonds exempt from taxation.  Bonds and the income therefrom issued pursuant to this chapter shall be exempt from all state and county taxation except estate and transfer taxes. [L 1981, c 236, pt of §1; am L 1986, c 146, §11]
